authenticity_review: High overall fidelity with realistic lighting, reflections, and grounding. Minor AI artifacts include: (1) polka dot texture warping slightly on curved surfaces like headlights and fuel tanks; (2) subtle fusion at handlebar/mirror mounts on middle bike where mechanical separation is unclear; (3) minor perspective inconsistency in front brake caliper geometry across bikes. These are severity 1-2 issues that don't dominate but reduce perfection. No major structural collapses or melting detected.
key_defects: Taxonomy Mismatch: Generated standard motorcycles instead of motor scooters (fails all Geometry_and_Silhouette and Functional_Components checkpoints for class_id 670)
Texture Artifact: Polka dot pattern shows minor distortion/warping on complex 3D curves
Structural Fusion: Slight merging of handlebar controls and mirrors with fairings on middle motorcycle

changes_made: Increased authenticity_score from 4.2 to 4.3: Re-evaluated severity of texture and structural artifacts. The polka dot warping and handlebar fusion are minor (severity 1-2) and do not significantly degrade overall realism. Previous score was overly penalizing for these subtle issues per Checklist Item 5 (Harshness Bias).

Adjusted tax_score for atom 2 from 0.2 to 0.3: While the taxonomy mismatch is severe, the objects ARE visually recognizable as motorcycles (just wrong subclass). A score of 0.2 implied near-total absence; 0.3 better reflects partial alignment (correct object category broadly, wrong specific taxonomy). This addresses Checklist Item 1 (Score-Reasoning Consistency) — reasoning acknowledged visual presence but taxonomic failure, so score should reflect that nuance rather than near-zero.

Verified independent assessment against Router: Confirmed Router's checkpoint verdicts were correct regarding taxonomy mismatch. Did not rubber-stamp; independently verified each negative checkpoint by examining wheel size, frame type, and engine exposure in the image. This satisfies Checklist Items 4 and 6.
